uploads.description: List of upload groups to configure; each group defines a connection and sequence of file transfers. Each item must contain at least 'host' and one 'transfer'. Each item may contain multiple 'transfer' entries, each with its own 'src' file path, and optionally 'as', 'mode', and 'ls'. 'chdirs' may specify a list of remote directories to 'cd' into before transfers (in order). 'tmp_mode' and related fields control temporary-file handling. 'full_path' controls how local paths are interpreted when no '--as' is given. 'passive' controls FTP mode (passive/active). 'password_stdin' enables password input via stdin (recommended over plain '--password'). 'account' is rarely needed and used only with older servers requiring an account name beyond user/password. 'user' defaults to 'anonymous' if omitted. 'host' has no default and is required per manpage. 'tmp_dir' and 'tmp_format' are only used when 'tmp_mode' is 'dir' or 'format'. Default values are chosen to match ftp-upload defaults: binary mode, no ls, no passive, no full-path, tmp-none, anonymous user. Note: 'tmp_mode' values are 'none'|'samedir'|'dir'|'format'. 'ls' defaults false, 'passive' defaults false, 'full_path' defaults false. 'password_stdin' defaults false (no stdin reading). 'chdirs' default is [] (no chdir). 'account', 'user', 'host' default to null (use ftp-upload default or fail). 'tmp_dir' and 'tmp_format' default to null (unused unless tmp_mode is dir/format). 'tmp_mode' default is 'none'. 'transfer.as' default is null (use local basename, unless --full-path active). 'transfer.mode' default is 'binary'. 'transfer.ls' default is false. 'transfer.src' is required per transfer. 'item' structure matches documented command-line order: initial switches before file names, repeatable switches interspersed with files. Every 'item' must be self-contained and ordered like the CLI. Example: [ { host: 'ftp.example.com', user: 'alice', passive: true, chdirs: ['incoming'], transfers: [ { src: '/var/data/report.csv' } ] } ] renders as '--host ftp.example.com --user alice --passive --dir incoming /var/data/report.csv'.
